_docs.overview: Planets are generated from a seed. Each seed deterministically picks a biome and applies its parameters with seed-driven noise. Edit values → relaunch → watch terminal for 'Item_PlanetType(seed=...) biome=...' to verify changes.
_docs.biome_selection: biomeOrder (below) defines a stable list for seed-based iteration. Same seed always picks the same biome. To see a specific biome, change the seed in gameConfig.txt until you get the one you want.

field_reference.surfaceTint: [R, G, B] 0.0-1.0 — Base color of the planet surface. Higher = brighter. Mixed with seed-driven noise controlled by blendStrength. Also used as colorPalette[0] if no palette is defined.
field_reference.colorPalette: [[R,G,B], [R,G,B], [R,G,B], [R,G,B]] — 4 colors the shader mixes across the surface using noise-driven gradient. All 4 should be in the same color family for a coherent biome.
field_reference.blendStrength: 0.0-1.0 — How much random noise mixes with each palette color. 0.0 = pure palette (exact JSON colors), 0.4 = moderate blending (default), 1.0 = pure noise (palette ignored).
field_reference.atmoDensityRange: [min, max] — Atmosphere thickness and glow. 0.0 = no atmosphere (sharp edge), 1.0 = Earth-like, 2.0 = very thick (Venus-like haze).
field_reference.cloudLevelRange: [min, max] — Cloud layer height relative to surface. Negative = below surface (hidden). 0.0 = surface level. 0.15 = raised clouds visible as bright bands.
field_reference.oceanLevelRange: [min, max] — Fraction of surface covered by water. 0.0 = no ocean, 0.3 = moderate (Earth-like), 1.0 = fully water world.
field_reference.hasRings: true/false — Whether this biome typically has rings. Gas giants and ice worlds usually have rings.
field_reference.ringProbability: 0.0-1.0 — Ring probability (used if biome doesn't specify hasRings). 0.6 = 60% of planets have rings.
field_reference.wavelengthBase: [R, G, B] — Atmospheric scattering color. Lower = more scattering (redder horizon). [0.66, 0.53, 0.4] = Earth-like blue sky.
field_reference.wavelengthJitter: 0.0-1.0 — Random ± variation per wavelength component. 0.1 = each channel varies ±0.1.
field_reference.desaturationRange: [min, max] — Surface color saturation. 0.0 = fully saturated (vivid), 1.0 = fully grey.
field_reference.atmoTintSaturationRange: [min, max] — Atmosphere glow saturation. 0.5 = somewhat grey, 1.0 = vivid colored.
field_reference.rotationSpeed: float — Planet spin speed (radians/frame). 0.0001 = slow, 0.0005 = fast. Pending engine wiring.
field_reference.cloudWindSpeed: float — Cloud layer drift speed. 0.0005 = moderate. Pending engine wiring.
field_reference.dockCapacity: int — Number of docking ports on the planet. -1 = no docks (open interior). 0 = dockable but no auto-docks.
field_reference.scale: int — Planet radius in engine units. 100000 = standard.

tips.remove_all_rings: Set hasRings: false on the biome, or ringProbability: 0.0 in defaults
tips.exact_color_match: Set blendStrength: 0.0 and define all 4 colorPalette entries to your target color

_docs.merge_rule: Defaults are loaded first; biome values override them. If a biome omits a field, the defaults value is used. Range fields use the 'first range wins' pattern: biome-specific range replaces the default range entirely (no min/max merging).
